entries.TITLE: PST — Predictive Single-Cell Transition Score
entries.CLAIM: A retained synthetic-controlled PST compact experiment package was executed and recovered. The neural PST variant shows strong in-domain ranking but does not beat the strongest simple raw-expression/logistic control on the recovered generator, calibration worsens the recorded compact metrics, and fixed family-A to family-B transfer is weak.
entries.CODE: Original isolated implementation was recorded under /mnt/data/pst_prompt6_bundle/projects/MODEL-PST but is not migrated into canonical Git. Current canonical path contains the evidence-recovery/validation package rather than the original neural source tree.
entries.TESTS: Recovered handoff records python -m pytest -q: 7 passed; placeholder and manuscript checks also passed. Canonical recovery validators/regressions preserve claim boundaries but do not substitute for rerunning the original implementation.
entries.EXPERIMENT: Smoke: seed 11, synthetic family A. Compact: seeds 11/29/47, 21 runs across main plus six variants. Transfer: seed 71, family A to family B. Family-B in-domain: seed 71.
entries.RESULT: Main calibrated PST AUROC 0.9744±0.0115, AUPRC 0.9101±0.0320, Top-K precision 0.8235±0.0519, ECE 0.1692±0.0089, Brier 0.0769±0.0095. Raw-expression logistic AUROC 0.9968 and AUPRC 0.9882. Fixed A→B transfer AUROC 0.6577, AUPRC 0.2877; B in-domain retraining AUROC 0.9903, AUPRC 0.9635.
EVIDENCE: retained File Library handoff MODEL-PST.md and compact manuscript
historical recovery PR #209 exact head 306045f7f65f70d6958b9b62fc1f1b1384fa9a71 with canonical CI 31450400849
entries.NEXT_ACTION: Recover a byte-identical Prompt-6 source/evidence tree or archive/manifest; hash and migrate it without reconstruction; rerun the recovered compact protocol from a canonical immutable commit; only then evaluate whether a leakage-safe licensed real-data protocol is justified.

entries.TESTS: Recovered isolated execution records 17 tests passed. Current recovery gate validates evidence boundaries but does not independently rerun the original NPMS implementation.
entries.EXPERIMENT: Recovered smoke: 2 runs. Compact: 15 runs, 36 ablation records, five controlled systems, seeds 7/19/41. Robustness: 45 records. Evidence class SYNTHETIC_CONTROLLED.
